summary: One church. The schedule box (identical in both November bulletins and matching the website) gives Mon-Sat noon Mass except Thursday, Thursday 7 PM Spanish Mass, Saturday 5 PM, Sunday 8/10/12, Thursday and First Friday Adoration and Confession; plus a Thanksgiving 9 AM Mass. Open: a First Friday 7 PM Mass seen only in intentions, and whether the Eucharistic Chapel's 7 AM-7 PM hours count as Adoration.

slots.rationale: R29, R11: only the Nov 1-8 intentions list a 7:00 PM Mass under 'FIRST FRIDAY NOVEMBER 6'; the schedule box and website don't list it. It fits the box: First Friday Adoration ends 6:50 PM and confession runs 6:00-6:50 PM. Seen in one first-Friday week only (the newest week holds none). Leaning include; C1 does not apply since nothing contradicts it.
slots.question: Add a First Friday 7:00 PM Mass?

sources.said: EUCHARISTIC CHAPEL/ CAPILLA MONDAY -SATURDAY 7:00am- 7:00pm When there is a service in the Church, the chapel will be closed. Cuando haya adoración en la Iglesia, la capilla estará cerrada.
EUCHARISTIC CHAPEL/ CAPILLA MONDAY -SATURDAY 7:00am- 7:00pm When there is a service in the Church, the chapel will be closed. Cuando haya adoración en la Iglesia, la capilla estará cerrada.
Eucharistic Chapel Monday - Saturday / Lunes a Sábado 7:00 am - 7:00 pm When there is a service in the Church, the chapel will be closed.

slots.rationale: R30, R38: the chapel's hours are listed separately from 'Eucharistic Adoration' and neither the bulletin nor the website calls them Adoration or says where the chapel is; POLICY says a chapel merely open for prayer is not an Adoration schedule. Leaning leave out. Include only if the chapel is on site and its hours are prayer before the Blessed Sacrament.
slots.question: Record the Eucharistic Chapel's Mon-Sat 7 AM-7 PM hours as Adoration?
